WITH shelved_metadata AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), top_memory_range_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata AS sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names AS tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC, sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid
WITH forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = (SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID), (SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE) AS per_state) AS avg_state_counts), display_name_memory_stddev AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.NETWORK_INFO, f.window_column, f.total_forge_instances_in_state, f.avg_forge_instances_per_state, dms.memory_mb_stddev, dms.deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM forge_instances AS f JOIN display_name_memory_stddev AS dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.UUID
WITH MemoryByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.total_memory_mb, am.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > am.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < am.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am), StddevOutliersByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), CombinedDisplayNames AS (SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High Total Memory vs Benchmark' AS reason FROM MemoryByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS total_memory_mb, NULL AS benchmark, NULL AS memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, 'High Memory Stddev vs Average' AS reason FROM StddevOutliersByDisplayName) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, reason FROM CombinedDisplayNames ORDER BY display_name, reason
WITH CacheTop10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), AverageCache AS (SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_records > ac.avg_cache_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE' WHEN ic.cache_records < ac.avg_cache_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE' END AS cache_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageCache AS ac), MetadataDispersion AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN (SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(meta_count_range) AS meta_count_range, AVG(meta_count_variance) AS meta_count_variance, AVG(meta_count_stddev) AS meta_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) SELECT ct.display_name, ct.cache_records, ct.benchmark, ct.cache_category, md.meta_count_range, md.meta_count_variance, md.meta_count_stddev FROM CacheTop10 AS ct LEFT JOIN MetadataDispersion AS md ON md.display_name = ct.display_name ORDER BY ct.cache_records DESC, ct.display_name
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, ie.flavor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.hostname ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT ic.uuid, ic.hostname, ic.flavor, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) AS memory_per_vcpu_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = ic.uuid WHERE (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) > 2048), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / (SELECT MAX(inner_cte2.memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) > 0.75) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Meeting_MemoryPerVcpu_Threshold, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Above_75pct_Max_Memory, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid), 0), 2) AS Ratio_MemoryPerVcpuQualified_To_Above75pctMaxMemory FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2
WITH mem_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0)), StateZoneTotals AS (SELECT i.vm_state, i.availability_zone, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.vm_state = i.vm_state WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state, i.availability_zone) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateZoneTotals GROUP BY vm_state, availability_zone WITH ROLLUP), launch_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), Benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_days_to_launch) AS benchmark_avg_days_to_launch FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_days_to_launch > b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch * 1.5 THEN 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' WHEN ic.avg_days_to_launch < b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch * 0.5 THEN 'FASTER_THAN_AVG' ELSE 'ABOUT_AVG' END AS speed_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark AS b), slow_display_names AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS slower_than_avg_display_name_count FROM launch_stats WHERE speed_category = 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG'), high_mem_groups AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_memory_state_zone_group_count FROM mem_rollup WHERE NOT availability_zone IN ('SUBTOTAL') AND NOT vm_state IN ('GRAND TOTAL')) SELECT hmg.high_memory_state_zone_group_count, sdn.slower_than_avg_display_name_count FROM high_mem_groups AS hmg CROSS JOIN slow_display_names AS sdn
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages AS za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS AS m2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY q1.availability_zone, q1.project_id, q1.instance_id
WITH memory_stats_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC), forge_metadata_windowed AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.`key` AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.window_column, stats.total_rows, stats.avg_window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) AS stats ON 1 = 1) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_stats_by_display_name) AS qualifying_display_name_count, (SELECT total_rows FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_total_rows, (SELECT avg_window_column FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_avg_running_sum_id
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, q2.min_instance_id, q2.avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME
WITH CompletedMigrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0), InstanceMemory AS (SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory AS im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am ORDER BY im.migration_id), Flare3HighMemInstances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_display_name, cm.rank_within_status, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb, f.uuid AS flare3_instance_uuid, f.vm_state AS flare3_vm_state, f.memory_mb AS flare3_memory_mb, f.network_info AS flare3_network_info, f.window_column AS flare3_windowed_avg_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN Flare3HighMemInstances AS f ON f.display_name = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id, f.memory_mb

AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND AS i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT ips.instance_id, ips.instance_uuid, ips.user_id, ips.project_id, ips.display_name, vst.avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM instance_project_window_stats AS ips JOIN vm_state_memory_thresholds AS vst ON ips.vm_state = vst.vm_state ORDER BY ips.instance_id
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(launched_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(launched_at AS CHAR) END AS launched_at, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, launched_at WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(per_instance_counts.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name) AS avg_counts ON inner_cte.display_name = avg_counts.display_name WHERE avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.launched_at, q1.max_memory_mb, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.avg_meta_entry_count FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name WHERE q1.display_name <> 'GRAND TOTAL' AND q1.launched_at <> 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY q1.display_name, q1.launched_at
WITH MigrationStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.migration_type, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(m.memory_total) AS min_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY m.status, m.migration_type), GroupAverages AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.migration_count * 1.0) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.min_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.migration_count > (SELECT avg_migration_count FROM GroupAverages)), VmStateMemoryDispersion AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, VARIANCE(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) SELECT ms.status, ms.migration_type, ms.migration_count, ms.min_memory_total, vms.vm_state, vms.memory_mb_variance, vms.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats AS ms JOIN VmStateMemoryDispersion AS vms ON vms.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY ms.migration_count DESC, ms.status, ms.migration_type
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.instance_uuid) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_system_metadata_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.display_name) AS above_avg_memory_instances_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2
WITH completed_migration_memory_deviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0), InstanceMemory AS (SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory AS im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am ORDER BY im.migration_id), high_memory_shelved_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cmd.migration_id) AS completed_migrations_for_high_memory_shelved_instances_count, COUNT(DISTINCT hms.DISPLAY_NAME) AS high_memory_shelved_instance_display_names_count FROM completed_migration_memory_deviation AS cmd JOIN high_memory_shelved_instances AS hms ON cmd.instance_display_name = hms.DISPLAY_NAME
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries, MAX(i2.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_in_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_entries DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, q1.metadata_entries, q1.max_vcpus_in_display_name, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.metadata_entries DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_total_stddev, a.avg_memory_total_stddev, (c.memory_total_stddev - a.avg_memory_total_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.avg_memory_total_stddev, q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC
WITH top10_metadata_by_display_name AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) AS avg_metadata_entries FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_entries, ac.avg_metadata_entries, (ic.metadata_entries - ac.avg_metadata_entries) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_entries DESC), high_memory_stddev_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), StddevAverage AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_display_names_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_memory_stddev_display_names) AS high_memory_stddev_display_names_count FROM top10_metadata_by_display_name
WITH top_projects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instances AS i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ORDER BY AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT WITH RootDiskTotals AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50), avg_totals AS (SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals AS at), MigrationMemoryCVByImageType AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT ism.value AS image_type, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ism.value ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT rdt.DISPLAY_NAME AS entity_name, rdt.total_root_gb AS metric_value, 'High Total Root Disk (GB)' AS reason FROM RootDiskTotals AS rdt UNION ALL SELECT mmc.image_type AS entity_name, mmc.max_coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Max Migration Memory Remaining CV (Completed Migrations)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryCVByImageType AS mmc) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name
WITH migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.migration_status, i.instance_vm_state, i.migration_count, i.earliest_migration_created_at, (i.migration_count - a.avg_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), memory_variance_by_state AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac) SELECT ms.migration_status, ms.instance_vm_state, ms.migration_count, ms.earliest_migration_created_at, ms.deviation_from_avg_migration_count, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_variance_benchmark, mv.variance_category FROM migration_stats AS ms JOIN memory_variance_by_state AS mv ON ms.instance_vm_state = mv.VM_STATE
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.`key`, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.`key`, ic.value, ic.window_column, av.avg_window_min_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - av.avg_window_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS av), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC) SELECT q1.status AS migration_status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb, q1.`key` AS system_metadata_key, q1.value AS system_metadata_value, q1.window_column AS window_min_memory_mb, q1.avg_window_min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min, q2.cache_records, q2.avg_cache_records, q2.deviation_from_avg AS cache_records_deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = q1.instance_uuid WHERE i.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY q2.cache_records DESC, q1.instance_uuid

av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance AS av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC), instances_in_flare3_with_cache AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, COUNT(ic.uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.vm_state) AS total_instances_in_vm_state, avg_states.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM (SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state) AS sub) AS avg_states ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedInstanceInsights AS (SELECT iic.uuid, iic.display_name, iic.vm_state, iic.memory_mb, iic.network_info, iic.window_column, iic.total_instances_in_vm_state, iic.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, vbdn.memory_mb_variance, vbdn.avg_memory_mb_variance, vbdn.deviation_from_avg_variance, 'Flare3 Instance With Cache' AS Reason FROM instances_in_flare3_with_cache AS iic JOIN variance_by_display_name AS vbdn ON iic.display_name = vbdn.display_name UNION ALL SELECT iic.uuid, iic.display_name, iic.vm_state, iic.memory_mb, iic.network_info, iic.window_column, iic.total_instances_in_vm_state, iic.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, vbdn.memory_mb_variance, vbdn.avg_memory_mb_variance, vbdn.deviation_from_avg_variance, 'Display Name Memory Variance Summary' AS Reason FROM variance_by_display_name AS vbdn JOIN instances_in_flare3_with_cache AS iic ON iic.display_name = vbdn.display_name) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceInsights ORDER BY display_name, uuid, Reason

WITH forge_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), DisplayNameAverages AS (SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), flare3_stddevs AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, av.avg_memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - av.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS forge_instances_above_avg_memory_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare3_stddevs) AS flare3_display_names_with_stddev_count FROM forge_above_avg AS fa JOIN flare3_stddevs AS fs ON fs.display_name = fa.display_name
WITH memory_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, a.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > a.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < a.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC), metadata_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, overall_avg.avg_migration_metadata_count AS overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(migration_metadata_count) AS avg_migration_metadata_count FROM (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_counts) AS overall_avg), CombinedInstanceStats AS (SELECT mv.display_name, 'Memory MB Variance' AS metric_type, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metric_value, mv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, mv.variance_category AS category, NULL AS metadata_count_range, NULL AS metadata_count_variance, NULL AS metadata_count_stddev, NULL AS overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM memory_variance AS mv UNION ALL SELECT ms.display_name, 'Per-migration Metadata Count Dispersion' AS metric_type, NULL AS metric_value, NULL AS benchmark_value, NULL AS category, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev, ms.overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM metadata_stats AS ms) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceStats ORDER BY display_name, metric_type
WITH geom_means_by_status AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, EXP(AVG(LN(i.vcpus))) AS geometric_mean_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.vcpus > 0 GROUP BY m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), max_project_memory_range_by_status AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), StatusProjectRanges AS (SELECT m.status, i.project_id, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS project_memory_mb_range FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status, i.project_id) SELECT spr.status, MAX(spr.project_memory_mb_range) AS max_project_memory_mb_range FROM StatusProjectRanges AS spr JOIN inner_cte AS base ON base.status = spr.status GROUP BY spr.status ORDER BY max_project_memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT g.status, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, g.geometric_mean_vcpus, r.max_project_memory_mb_range FROM geom_means_by_status AS g JOIN max_project_memory_range_by_status AS r ON r.status = g.status ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC
WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges AS a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC), mig_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range, mg.status AS migration_status, mg.max_memory_total, mg.memory_mb AS configured_memory_mb, mg.vcpus AS configured_vcpus, ROUND(mg.max_memory_total / NULLIF(mg.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS max_migration_memory_to_configured_memory_ratio FROM mem_stats AS ms JOIN mig_stats AS mg ON mg.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY max_migration_memory_to_configured_memory_ratio DESC
WITH top_groups_2014 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND NOT ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, COUNT(fi.instance_uuid) AS forge_instance_count_in_group, MAX(CASE WHEN fi.has_deleted_instance_extra = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_forge_instance_has_deleted_instance_extra FROM top_groups_2014 AS tg LEFT JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME, tg.LAUNCHED_AT, tg.max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology ORDER BY tg.max_memory_mb DESC
WITH variance_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte)), cov_and_meta AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name, (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT v.display_name, v.memory_mb_variance, v.memory_mb_stddev, c.coefficient_of_variation, c.system_metadata_rows, c.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM variance_above_avg AS v JOIN cov_and_meta AS c ON c.display_name = v.display_name ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 1000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS migrated_instance_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_total_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_variance DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.migrated_instance_count, q2.has_active_migrations, q1.memory_mb_variance FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.VM_STATE = q2.VM_STATE ORDER BY q2.memory_total_variance DESC
WITH forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ic.UPDATED_AT AS cache_updated_at FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT fi.display_name, fi.uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.network_info AS forge_cached_network_info, fi.cache_id AS forge_cache_id, fi.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, fi.total_forge_instances, fi.avg_forge_memory_mb, so.hostname AS shelved_offloaded_hostname, so.memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb, so.vcpus AS shelved_offloaded_vcpus, so.cache_updated_at AS shelved_offloaded_cache_updated_at, ROUND(fi.memory_mb / NULLIF(so.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS forge_to_shelved_offloaded_memory_ratio FROM forge_instances AS fi JOIN shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS so ON so.instance_uuid = fi.uuid ORDER BY fi.memory_mb
WITH mem_over_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), completed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id) = MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, migration_id, INSTANCE_UUID, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, MEMORY_MB, VCPUS, instance_extra_id, MEMORY_TOTAL, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id), filtered_completed_migrations AS (SELECT cm.migration_type, cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, moa.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations AS cm JOIN mem_over_avg AS moa ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = moa.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cm.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id, fcm.INSTANCE_UUID, fcm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_HOST, fcm.DISPLAY_NAME, fcm.VM_STATE, fcm.MEMORY_MB, fcm.VCPUS, fcm.instance_extra_id, fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL, fcm.window_column, fcm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL / NULLIF(fcm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS migration_memory_to_instance_total_memory_ratio FROM filtered_completed_migrations AS fcm ORDER BY fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM INSTANCES AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, (inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 / totals.grand_total_memory_mb) AS pct_of_included_total_memory FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SUM(total_memory_mb) AS grand_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS totals ON 1 = 1), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb, q1.pct_of_included_total_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.pct_of_included_total_memory DESC, q2.instance_count DESC, q2.DISPLAY_NAME

WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name), lag_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS avg_cache_update_lag, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS cache_update_lag_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_update_lag_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, MAX(cache_update_lag_stddev) AS max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name) SELECT mem_stats.display_name, mem_stats.total_instances, mem_stats.avg_memory_mb, mem_stats.memory_mb_variance, lag_stats.max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM mem_stats LEFT JOIN lag_stats ON lag_stats.display_name = mem_stats.display_name ORDER BY mem_stats.display_name
