WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(memory_range_mb) AS total_memory_range_mb, AVG(memory_variance_mb) AS avg_memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), KeyAgg AS (SELECT ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ism.`KEY`) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, SUM(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus, (SELECT min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_min_memory_mb, (SELECT total_vcpus FROM inner_cte) AS overall_total_vcpus FROM KeyAgg GROUP BY metadata_key WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_memory_range_mb, q1.avg_memory_variance_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.min_memory_mb, q2.total_vcpus, q2.overall_min_memory_mb, q2.overall_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.total_vcpus / NULLIF(q2.overall_total_vcpus, 0), 4) AS vcpu_share_of_overall FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.display_name, q2.metadata_key
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_migration_id, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb, b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC) SELECT q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg, q1.min_migration_id, q1.avg_instance_memory_mb, q1.benchmark, q1.memory_category FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.metadata_records DESC
WITH MaxMemoryRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.`key`, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.`key` HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(`key`) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE `key` END AS `key`, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, `key` WITH ROLLUP), MigrationMemoryAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mmr.display_name AS display_name, mmr.`key` AS metadata_key, mmr.max_memory_mb AS metric_value, '2014 Prime Max Memory (Rollup)' AS reason FROM MaxMemoryRollup AS mmr UNION ALL SELECT mma.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, NULL AS metadata_key, mma.avg_instance_memory_mb AS metric_value, 'Completed Migration Avg Memory Above Overall Avg' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryAboveAvg AS mma) SELECT display_name, metadata_key, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY display_name, reason, metadata_key
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_processed DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN LAG(instance_display_name) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key ORDER BY instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = instance_display_name THEN NULL ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, total_migrations, running_sum_migration_ids FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_migrations, MAX(window_column) AS running_sum_migration_ids FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key, instance_display_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.migration_count, q1.total_memory_processed, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.metadata_key, q2.total_migrations, q2.running_sum_migration_ids FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.instance_display_name WHERE q2.metadata_key = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.total_memory_processed DESC, q1.instance_uuid
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12', (SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM (SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host) AS sub) AS avg_stats), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_name, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.vm_state AS az_host_vm_state, q2.total_memory_mb AS az_host_total_memory_mb FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.UUID, q2.vm_state
WITH prime_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC), flare_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedResults AS (SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability AS pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory AS fm) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name
WITH mem_by_vm_state AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name), root_by_vm_state AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_root_gb, inner_cte.root_gb_range, inner_cte.root_gb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.root_gb_range DESC) SELECT m.vm_state, m.avg_memory_mb, m.memory_mb_range, m.memory_mb_variance, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance, r.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM mem_by_vm_state AS m LEFT JOIN root_by_vm_state AS r ON r.VM_STATE = m.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.vm_state IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.vm_state
WITH migration_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_rank AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_column, (ic.window_column - ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank AS ar), instance_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_in_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state) AS state_counts ON inner_cte.vm_state = state_counts.vm_state, (SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_instances_per_state FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state) AS sub) AS avg_state_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column AS memory_mb_window_avg, id.total_in_state, id.avg_instances_per_state, md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.flavor, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, md.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank, md.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS migration_dense_rank_deviation FROM instance_details AS id JOIN migration_details AS md ON id.display_name = md.display_name WHERE id.total_in_state > id.avg_instances_per_state ORDER BY id.memory_mb
WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, (i.ROOT_GB * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.MEMORY_MB, 0)) * 100.0 AS root_gb_pct_of_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, CASE WHEN GROUPING(hostname) = 1 AND GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(hostname) = 1 AND GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE hostname END AS hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_extra_id) AS total_instance_extra_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT metadata_key) AS total_metadata_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_uuid, hostname WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.window_column, q1.root_gb_pct_of_memory_mb, q2.hostname, q2.total_instance_extra_ids, WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), mig_cv AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS sort_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, mc.coefficient_of_variation FROM mem_stats AS ms JOIN mig_cv AS mc ON ms.display_name = mc.display_name ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_variance DESC

ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id), memory_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), DisplayNameHostAgg AS (SELECT i.host, ic.display_name, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'HasMemory' ELSE ic.display_name GROUP BY i.host, ic.display_name, memory_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(host) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE host END AS host, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host) = memory_status, SUM(display_name_rows) AS display_name_rows, AVG(avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameHostAgg GROUP BY host, display_name, memory_status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT md.migration_id, md.instance_uuid, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.instance_display_name, md.metadata_key, md.metadata_value, md.window_column AS WITH cov_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cov AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), overall_cte AS (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean, (ic.geometric_mean - oc.overall_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_cte AS oc ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, avg_memory_total, memory_total_variance, avg_instance_memory_mb FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_total, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_total, inner_cte.memory_total_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), status_summary AS (SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status) SELECT i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.display_name, i.flavor, i.window_column, s.total_completed_migrations, s.distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_summary AS s ON i.status = s.status
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS contributing_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS reservation_delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY reservation_delta_stddev DESC) SELECT inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev, AVG(qu.IN_USE) AS avg_in_use FROM inner_cte JOIN QUOTA_USAGES AS qu ON qu.RESOURCE = inner_cte.resource AND qu.DELETED = 0 WHERE inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta > 0.10 * qu.IN_USE GROUP BY inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state), StateNameAgg AS (SELECT vm_state, display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(extra_record_count) AS total_extra_records, SUM(extra_id_sum) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, display_name) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances, SUM(total_extra_records) AS total_extra_records, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateNameAgg GROUP BY vm_state, display_name WITH ROLLUP
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, avg_memory_remaining_bytes, memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, AVG(memory_remaining_stddev_bytes) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS migrated_instance_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_total_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_variance DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > (SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations)) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, i.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sg.PROJECT_ID, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sg.ID ORDER BY sgr.ID) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0), RuleCounts AS (SELECT NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte GROUP BY NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE NAME END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS security_group_description, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROTOCOL) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE PROTOCOL END AS protocol, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleCounts GROUP BY NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL WITH ROLLUP
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND NOT ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.project_id AS project_id, SUM(inner_cte.instance_memory_mb) AS total_migrated_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = inner_cte.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM (SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.instance_display_name) AS inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.project_id ORDER BY total_migrated_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb HAVING AVG(i2.memory_mb) > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_range_mb DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(launched_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(launched_at AS CHAR) END AS launched_at, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, launched_at WITH ROLLUP
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.VM_STATE = inner_cte.VM_STATE AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_mb DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND c.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE) SELECT inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, overall_avg.overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT MAX(avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb_across_display_names FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, COUNT(inner_cte.ID) AS total_shelved_offloaded_instances, avg_az.avg_instance_count AS avg_shelved_offloaded_instances_per_az FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(ID) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE) AS sub) AS avg_az GROUP BY inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, avg_az.avg_instance_count
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_variance DESC), tcp_rule_counts AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(*) AS tcp_rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME), avg_tcp_rule_count AS (SELECT AVG(tcp_rule_count * 1.0) AS avg_tcp_rule_count FROM tcp_rule_counts) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.from_port_variance, trc.tcp_rule_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN tcp_rule_counts AS trc ON i.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name CROSS JOIN avg_tcp_rule_count AS a WHERE trc.tcp_rule_count > a.avg_tcp_rule_count ORDER BY i.from_port_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_id) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.project_id) AS total_forge_instances_in_project, avg_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(forge_instance_count) AS avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS per_project_counts) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, c.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_HOST, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.cached_network_info, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.migration_id) OVER () AS total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, avg_by_dest.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(migrations_per_dest) AS avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM (SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS migrations_per_dest FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS per_dest) AS avg_by_dest ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.`KEY`, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), MemoryTierCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.metadata_key, CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_memory_mb >= 32768 THEN 'Very Large' ELSE 'Large' END AS memory_tier, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.metadata_key, memory_tier) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(memory_tier) = 1 AND GROUPING(metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE memory_tier END AS memory_tier, SUM(total_groups) AS total_groups FROM MemoryTierCounts GROUP BY metadata_key, memory_tier WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev AS a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT inner_cte.shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON 1 = 1 JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache

SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceExtraMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), ImageTypeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT iemv.display_name, iemv.memory_mb_variance, itms.avg_memory_mb, itms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceExtraMemoryVariance AS iemv JOIN ImageTypeMemoryStats AS itms ON iemv.display_name = itms.display_name ORDER BY iemv.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT i1.uuid) AS instance_extra_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i2.uuid) AS image_type_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i1 ON i1.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i1.uuid JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC

AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'), completed_migrations_memory AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type AS (SELECT cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.instance_hostname, cmm.migration_source_compute, cmm.migration_dest_compute, cmm.migration_dest_host, cmm.migration_type, cmm.memory_total, cmm.memory_processed, cmm.memory_remaining, cmm.window_column AS WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type') SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type), flare3_migrations_detail AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'), flare3_avg_memory_remaining AS (SELECT AVG(fmd.memory_remaining * 1.0) AS WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC), CompletedMigrationInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) SELECT cmd.DISPLAY_NAME, cmd.UUID AS instance_uuid, cmd.DEST_HOST, cmd.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, cmd.window_column AS avg_instance_memory_mb_within_uuid_by_dest_host, ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes / NULLIF(cmd.MEMORY_MB * 1024 * 1024, 0), 6) AS avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationInstanceDetails AS cmd JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON cmd.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio DESC), AverageRatio AS (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_uuid, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb_within_uuid_by_dest_host, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ic.avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio - ar.overall_avg_ratio) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_ratio FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageRatio AS ar ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg_ratio DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.hostname, fim.metadata_key, fim.window_column, NULL AS migration_count_range, NULL AS migration_count_variance, NULL AS migration_count_stddev, 'Forge Instance Metadata' AS reason FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata AS fim UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS hostname, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS window_column, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, 'Migration Stats By Display Name' AS reason FROM MigrationStatsByDisplayName AS ms WHERE ms.display_name = 'forge') SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_uuid, hostname, metadata_key) SELECT icr.instance_uuid, icr.hostname, icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, 'Above-key average running-sum (non-deleted cache only)' AS reason FROM inner_cte AS icr JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = icr.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE icr.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic.deleted = 0 AND icr.window_column > (SELECT AVG(icr2.window_column * 1.0) FROM inner_cte AS icr2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = icr2.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE icr2.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND icr2.metadata_key = icr.metadata_key) ORDER BY icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, icr.instance_uuid

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.UUID AS instance_uuid, f.HOSTNAME AS hostname, s.display_name, s.project_id, s.power_state, s.metadata_key, s.metadata_value, f.VM_STATE AS vm_state, f.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, f.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, s.max_memory_mb_next_2, f.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS s ON s.instance_uuid = f.UUID ORDER BY f.UUID, s.metadata_key), InstanceVcpu AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.VCPUS AS vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i), AverageVcpu AS (SELECT AVG(v.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus FROM InstanceVcpu AS v JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.display_name, ic.project_id, ic.power_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.max_memory_mb_next_2, ic.min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, v.vcpus, (v.vcpus - av.avg_vcpus) AS deviation_from_avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN InstanceVcpu AS v ON v.instance_uuid = ic.instance_uuid CROSS JOIN AverageVcpu AS av ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key

CompletedMigrationsRanked AS cmr JOIN MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus AS mm ON cmr.instance_display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, cmr.migration_id) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(instance_display_name) OVER (ORDER BY instance_sort, max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, migration_id) = instance_display_name THEN NULL ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), Flare3InstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.display_name, cm.vm_state, cm.max_memory_mb_next_2, fim.instance_uuid, fim.key_name, fim.metadata_entry_count, fim.total_vcpus, ROUND(fim.total_vcpus / NULLIF(fim.metadata_entry_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_vCPUs_Per_Metadata_Entry FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN migrations AS m ON m.id = cm.migration_id JOIN Flare3InstanceMetadata AS fim ON fim.instance_uuid = m.instance_uuid ORDER BY Avg_vCPUs_Per_Metadata_Entry DESC, cm.migration_id), StatusRollup AS (SELECT status, COUNT(DISTINCT migration_id) AS total_migrations, SUM(metadata_entry_count) AS total_metadata_entries, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_migrations) AS total_migrations, SUM(total_metadata_entries) AS total_metadata_entries, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(SUM(total_vcpus) / NULLIF(SUM(total_metadata_entries), 0), 2) AS Avg_vCPUs_Per_Metadata_Entry FROM StatusRollup GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT imcv.display_name, imcv.coefficient_of_variation, soms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMemoryCV AS imcv JOIN ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStddev AS soms ON imcv.display_name = soms.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC), AverageCV AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageCV AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed') SELECT soi.instance_uuid, soi.display_name AS shelved_display_name, soi.project_id, soi.power_state, soi.metadata_key, soi.metadata_value, soi.max_memory_mb_next_2, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following FROM ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS soi JOIN CompletedMigrations AS cm ON cm.uuid = soi.instance_uuid ORDER BY soi.instance_uuid) SELECT inner_cte.project_id, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_mb_next_2) AS max_of_instance_max_memory_mb_next_2, MAX(inner_cte.min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following) AS max_of_migration_min_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.project_id
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH StddevWithNetworkAndExtra AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT r.display_name, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance, r.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra, s.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache FROM RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra AS r JOIN StddevWithNetworkAndExtra AS s ON r.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 0 THEN 'DETAIL' ELSE 'TOTAL' END AS row_type, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev_with_extra) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev_with_extra, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.created_at, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10), Top10WithDetails AS (SELECT ic.display_name, ic.created_at, ic.max_memory_total, ic.coefficient_of_variation, i.uuid AS instance_uuid FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.created_at = ic.created_at JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(created_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(created_at AS CHAR) END AS created_at, MAX(max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM Top10WithDetails GROUP BY display_name, created_at WITH ROLLUP

= '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT d.instance_id, d.display_name, d.user_id, d.project_id, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.availability_zone, d.metadata_key, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.`key`, inner_cte.value, inner_cte.max_memory_mb_next2, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, i.project_id, pu.total_vcpus, pu.total_memory_mb, COALESCE(pam.has_active_migrations, 'No') AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN project_usage AS pu ON i.project_id = pu.project_id LEFT window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS AS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMigrationMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, InstanceMigrationMemoryCV AS imcv ON imw.DISPLAY_NAME = imcv.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.DEST_COMPUTE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, status, dest_compute, window_column, coefficient_of_variation, instances_in_dest_compute, WITH inner_cte AS (WITH UsageReservationStats AS (SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS q JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats AS urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion AS rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC), Benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation) AS benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.reservation_count, i.total_reserved_delta, i.delta_variance, i.delta_stddev, i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation, b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation > b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_DELTA' WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation < b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_AVG_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_AVG_DELTA' END AS avg_delta_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN Benchmark AS b ORDER BY i.delta_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), VmStateTotalMemory AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT gmm.vm_state, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, tms.total_memory_mb FROM VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS gmm JOIN VmStateTotalMemory AS tms ON gmm.vm_state = tms.vm_state ORDER BY tms.total_memory_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, geometric_mean_memory_mb, total_memory_mb FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH migration_mem_cv_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), geom_mean_mem_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mmc.vm_state, mmc.coefficient_of_variation, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migration_mem_cv_by_vm_state AS mmc JOIN geom_mean_mem_by_vm_state AS gmm ON mmc.vm_state = gmm.vm_state) SELECT ROUND(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb / 1024.0) * 1024 AS geom_mean_memory_mb_bucket_1024, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ROUND(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb / 1024.0) * 1024 ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.USER_ID, fi.PROJECT_ID, fi.HOSTNAME, fi.VM_STATE, fi.POWER_STATE, fi.MEMORY_MB, fi.VCPUS, fi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fi.info_cache_id, fi.NETWORK_INFO, fi.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(fi.MEMORY_MB / NULLIF(fi.window_column, 0), 2) AS memory_to_project_min_ratio FROM ForgeInstances AS fi JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY memory_to_project_min_ratio DESC
WITH InstanceCacheDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), ShelvedOffloadedMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), CombinedInstanceViews AS (SELECT sm.instance_uuid AS instance_uuid, sm.display_name AS display_name, sm.project_id AS project_id, sm.power_state AS power_state, sm.metadata_key AS metadata_key, sm.metadata_value AS metadata_value, sm.max_memory_mb_next_2 AS max_memory_mb_next_2, icd.vm_state AS vm_state, icd.memory_mb AS memory_mb, icd.network_info AS network_info, icd.window_column AS window_column, 'Shelved Offloaded With Metadata' AS reason FROM ShelvedOffloadedMetadata AS sm JOIN InstanceCacheDetails AS icd ON icd.display_name = sm.display_name AND icd.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, icd.display_name AS display_name, NULL AS project_id, NULL AS power_state, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS metadata_value, NULL AS max_memory_mb_next_2, icd.vm_state AS vm_state, icd.memory_mb AS memory_mb, icd.network_info AS network_info, icd.window_column AS window_column, 'Non-deleted Instance Cache Details' AS reason FROM InstanceCacheDetails AS icd) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceViews ORDER BY display_name, reason
WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), CombinedInstanceVariability AS (SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev AS metric_value, 'Instance Memory MB Stddev (non-deleted instances with system metadata; >5 rows)' AS reason FROM MemoryStddevByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Migration MEMORY_REMAINING Coefficient of Variation (completed migrations; avg>0)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByDisplayName) SELECT display_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedInstanceVariability ORDER BY display_name, reason
WITH RuleWindow AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER (PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), TopRuleCounts AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY rule_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.window_column, trc.rule_count, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(trc.rule_count, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_from_port_per_rule FROM RuleWindow AS rw JOIN TopRuleCounts AS trc ON rw.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name ORDER BY normalized_running_from_port_per_rule DESC, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT
WITH MemoryVarianceFromMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT mv.DISPLAY_NAME, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, mr.memory_range_mb, mr.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(mv.memory_mb_variance / NULLIF(mr.memory_range_mb, 0), 4) AS variance_to_range_ratio FROM MemoryVarianceFromMetadata AS mv JOIN MemoryRangeAndVariance AS mr ON mv.DISPLAY_NAME = mr.display_name ORDER BY variance_to_range_ratio DESC
WITH ShelvedCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.`key`, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), MigrationStatusVmStateStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state) SELECT scm.status, scm.source_compute, scm.dest_compute, scm.instance_uuid, scm.display_name, scm.memory_mb, scm.`key`, scm.value, scm.window_column, msvs.migration_count, msvs.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ShelvedCompletedMigrations AS scm JOIN MigrationStatusVmStateStats AS msvs ON msvs.migration_status = scm.status AND msvs.instance_vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
WITH MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS (SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance, COUNT(*) AS flare3_instance_count FROM MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = msmv.status JOIN Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f ON f.UUID = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY msmv.memory_mb_variance DESC
WITH AZInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), NotDeletedInstanceDenseRank AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), NotDeletedInstanceDenseRankWithUUID AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT az.uuid, az.display_name, az.vm_state, az.memory_mb, az.network_info, az.window_column AS Avg_MemoryMB_Window_2_Preceding_2_Following_By_VMState, nd.window_column AS Dense_Rank_By_Project FROM AZInstanceWindow AS az JOIN NotDeletedInstanceDenseRankWithUUID AS nd ON az.uuid = nd.uuid ORDER BY az.memory_mb
WITH az_instances_with_metadata_window AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'), shelved_offloaded_instances_with_network_rank AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_shelved_offloaded_instances_with_metadata_and_network_count FROM az_instances_with_metadata_window AS az JOIN shelved_offloaded_instances_with_network_rank AS so ON az.uuid = (SELECT i2.uuid FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.id = so.id AND i2.availability_zone = 'flare3')
WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE NOT i.memory_mb IS NULL GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), VMStateRootDiskStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), CombinedStats AS (SELECT status AS category, avg_memory_mb AS avg_value, memory_mb_variance AS variance_value, memory_mb_stddev AS stddev_value, NULL AS range_value, 'Migration Status Memory Stats' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryStats UNION ALL SELECT vm_state AS category, avg_root_gb AS avg_value, root_gb_variance AS variance_value, NULL AS stddev_value, root_gb_range AS range_value, 'VM State Root Disk Stats' AS reason FROM VMStateRootDiskStats) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY reason, category
