WITH InstanceMetadataAndExtraWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0), DisplayNameCacheStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN (SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC) SELECT im.instance_uuid, im.display_name, im.vm_state, im.power_state, im.memory_mb, im.vcpus, im.metadata_key, im.metadata_value, im.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, dn.cache_count_range, dn.cache_count_variance, dn.cache_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataAndExtraWindow AS im JOIN DisplayNameCacheStats AS dn ON im.display_name = dn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY dn.cache_count_range DESC, im.instance_uuid

WITH MigrationStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, mem.memory_mb_range, mem.memory_mb_variance, mem.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats AS ms JOIN MemoryStats AS mem ON ms.display_name = mem.display_name ORDER BY ms.migration_count_range DESC, mem.memory_mb_range DESC

WITH TopExtraByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY extra_records DESC LIMIT 10), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT te.display_name, te.extra_records, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM TopExtraByDisplayName AS te LEFT JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS mv ON te.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY te.extra_records DESC
WITH q1 AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), q2 AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT q1.migration_id, q1.status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.dest_host, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.max_memory_mb_next_2, q2.memory_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_2_pre_2_fol FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_id = q2.migration_id ORDER BY q1.migration_id

WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS (SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC
WITH TcpRuleStats AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS total_to_port FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION), GeoMeanPortRange AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, EXP(AVG(LN(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1))) AS geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.TO_PORT >= sgr.FROM_PORT GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_port_range_size DESC), CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics AS (SELECT t.security_group_id, t.security_group_name, t.security_group_description, t.rule_count, t.total_to_port, g.geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM TcpRuleStats AS t JOIN GeoMeanPortRange AS g ON t.security_group_name = g.security_group_name) SELECT security_group_id, security_group_name, security_group_description, rule_count, total_to_port, geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics ORDER BY security_group_name
WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.`key`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name, cm.`key` AS instance_system_metadata_key, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_per_instance_uuid, fi.UUID AS instance_uuid, fi.HOSTNAME, fi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fi.NETWORK_INFO, fi.window_column AS instance_rank_within_availability_zone FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN ForgeInstances AS fi ON fi.UUID = (SELECT i2.uuid FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = cm.display_name LIMIT 1)

WITH InstanceMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), DisplayNameMigrationMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT imw.instance_uuid, imw.instance_display_name, imw.migration_status, imw.window_column, dcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationWindow AS imw JOIN DisplayNameMigrationMemoryCV AS dcv ON imw.instance_display_name = dcv.display_name ORDER BY dcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.instance_display_name, imw.instance_uuid

WITH RuleWindow AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, AVG(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER (PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT), TcpPortCoverage AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.TO_PORT, rw.CIDR, rw.window_column AS avg_from_port_window_2_pre_2_fol, tpc.total_ports_covered, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(tpc.total_ports_covered, 0), 6) AS normalized_window_avg_to_total_ports_ratio FROM RuleWindow AS rw JOIN TcpPortCoverage AS tpc ON rw.security_group_name = tpc.security_group_name WHERE rw.security_group_name = 'aurum-xenon' ORDER BY normalized_window_avg_to_total_ports_ratio DESC, rw.FROM_PORT

WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000), sq2 AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.availability_zone HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0)) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.launched_at, sq1.max_memory_mb, sq2.availability_zone, sq2.total_memory_mb FROM sq1 CROSS JOIN sq2 ORDER BY sq2.total_memory_mb DESC, sq1.max_memory_mb DESC
WITH InstanceMetadataAndWindowMax AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndDenseRank AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.`KEY`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imwm.instance_uuid, imwm.display_name, imwm.vm_state, imwm.power_state, imwm.memory_mb, imwm.vcpus, imwm.metadata_key, imwm.metadata_value, ifdr.FLAVOR AS instance_extra_flavor_json, ifdr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_metadata_key, imwm.max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM InstanceMetadataAndWindowMax AS imwm JOIN InstanceFlavorAndDenseRank AS ifdr ON imwm.instance_uuid = ifdr.INSTANCE_UUID AND imwm.metadata_key = ifdr.`KEY` ORDER BY imwm.instance_uuid, imwm.metadata_key
WITH HostInstances AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), CompletedFlareMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), HostInstanceMigrationSummary AS (SELECT hi.instance_id, hi.instance_uuid, hi.user_id, hi.project_id, hi.display_name, hi.vm_state, hi.memory_mb, hi.vcpus, hi.info_cache_id, hi.max_instance_id_next_2, cfm.migration_id, cfm.migration_status, cfm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cfm.DEST_COMPUTE, cfm.instance_display_name, cfm.instance_memory_mb, cfm.instance_extra_id, cfm.window_column FROM HostInstances AS hi JOIN CompletedFlareMigrations AS cfm ON hi.instance_uuid = cfm.INSTANCE_UUID) SELECT hims.instance_id, hims.instance_uuid, hims.user_id, hims.project_id, hims.display_name, hims.vm_state, hims.memory_mb, hims.vcpus, hims.info_cache_id, hims.migration_id, hims.migration_status, hims.SOURCE_COMPUTE, hims.DEST_COMPUTE, hims.instance_extra_id, hims.max_instance_id_next_2, hims.window_column, ROUND(hims.memory_mb / NULLIF(hims.window_column, 0), 2) AS Memory_To_WindowMin_Ratio FROM HostInstanceMigrationSummary AS hims ORDER BY Memory_To_WindowMin_Ratio DESC, hims.migration_id
WITH InstanceMemoryDenseRank AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'), InstanceNetworkAndAvgMemory AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT imdr.instance_uuid, imdr.metadata_value, imdr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, inam.instance_display_name, inam.metadata_key, inam.network_info, inam.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window FROM InstanceMemoryDenseRank AS imdr JOIN InstanceNetworkAndAvgMemory AS inam ON imdr.instance_uuid = inam.instance_uuid AND imdr.metadata_value = inam.metadata_value ORDER BY imdr.instance_uuid
WITH windowed_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), host_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM windowed_instances) AS flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_memory_stats) AS blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM windowed_instances AS wi CROSS JOIN host_memory_stats AS hms LIMIT 1
WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), active_migration_stats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 AS (SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb FROM active_migration_stats AS ams JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = ams.instance_vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb) SELECT vsm.VM_STATE, vsm.memory_mb_variance, vsm.memory_mb_stddev, amsb.migration_status, amsb.migration_count, amsb.min_instance_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats AS vsm LEFT JOIN active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 AS amsb ON amsb.instance_vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE ORDER BY vsm.memory_mb_variance DESC, amsb.migration_count DESC
WITH completed_migrations_per_instance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.availability_zone, c.completed_migration_count, c.total_memory_processed, s.min_instance_id, s.avg_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_per_instance AS c JOIN instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS s ON c.instance_display_name = s.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.completed_migration_count DESC, c.total_memory_processed DESC
WITH MemoryStatsByMigrationStatus AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE NOT i.memory_mb IS NULL AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), ActiveMigrationDetailsWithWindowMax AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.`key`, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')) SELECT amd.status, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, amd.source_compute, amd.dest_compute, amd.dest_host, amd.instance_uuid, amd.display_name, amd.vm_state, amd.`key`, amd.value, amd.max_memory_mb_next2 FROM ActiveMigrationDetailsWithWindowMax AS amd JOIN MemoryStatsByMigrationStatus AS ms ON amd.status = ms.status
WITH BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS AS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) AS Ether_Completed_Migration_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT bcm.DISPLAY_NAME) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Blaze8_12_Completed_Migration_To_Same_Dest_Compute FROM EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ecmwm LEFT JOIN BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS bcm ON ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE = bcm.DEST_COMPUTE GROUP BY ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Ether_Completed_Migration_Count DESC, ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE

WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), VMStateVariation AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), VMStateMigrationCounts AS (SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state) SELECT md.migration_id, md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.max_memory_mb_next_2, vsv.coefficient_of_variation, vsmc.completed_migration_count FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN VMStateVariation AS vsv ON md.vm_state = vsv.vm_state JOIN VMStateMigrationCounts AS vsmc ON md.vm_state = vsmc.vm_state WHERE (vsmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(completed_migration_count) FROM VMStateMigrationCounts)) > 0.10 ORDER BY vsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, md.migration_id

WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT md.uuid AS instance_uuid, md.display_name, md.availability_zone, md.status AS migration_status, md.migration_type, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN InstanceMetadataStats AS ims ON md.uuid = ims.instance_uuid WHERE md.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY md.display_name, md.uuid

WITH cache_metrics AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN (SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC), memory_cv AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), top_cache_range AS (SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, cache_count_range FROM cache_metrics ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tcr.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.cache_count_range, cm.cache_count_variance, cm.cache_count_stddev, mc.coefficient_of_variation FROM top_cache_range AS tcr JOIN cache_metrics AS cm ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcr.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN memory_cv AS mc ON mc.display_name = tcr.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cm.cache_count_range DESC

WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.instance_uuid, md.instance_display_name, md.instance_hostname, md.migration_source_compute, md.migration_dest_compute, md.migration_dest_host, md.migration_type, md.memory_total, md.memory_processed, md.memory_remaining, md.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value, imn.NETWORK_INFO, imn.window_column AS metadata_value_row_number_window FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork AS imn ON md.instance_display_name = imn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY md.instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value

WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), PrimeInstancesWithImageType AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.display_name FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime')) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmrcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN MigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS mmrcv ON ims.display_name = mmrcv.display_name WHERE ims.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM PrimeInstancesWithImageType) ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmrcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), subq2 AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT subq2.instance_uuid, subq2.instance_display_name, subq2.availability_zone, subq2.completed_migration_count, subq2.total_memory_processed, subq1.window_column AS memory_dense_rank_window FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.instance_uuid = subq1.instance_uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_processed DESC

WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.hostname, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor_json, id.numa_topology_json, id.network_info_json, id.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpu_count, cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_in_migration_window FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN CompletedMigrations AS cm ON cm.INSTANCE_UUID = id.instance_uuid
WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare')), PrimeMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, pmv.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw LEFT JOIN PrimeMemoryVariance AS pmv ON imw.display_name = pmv.display_name ORDER BY imw.uuid
WITH PrimeInstanceMaxMemory AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), FlareCompletedMigrationsWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), FlareInstanceMemorySummary AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS flare_completed_migration_count, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT fms.instance_display_name, fms.flare_completed_migration_count, fms.avg_instance_memory_mb, fcmw.migration_id, fcmw.migration_status, fcmw.source_compute, fcmw.dest_compute, fcmw.instance_uuid, fcmw.instance_memory_mb, fcmw.instance_extra_id, fcmw.window_column FROM FlareInstanceMemorySummary AS fms JOIN FlareCompletedMigrationsWindow AS fcmw ON fms.instance_display_name = fcmw.instance_display_name WHERE (fms.avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.0 / fcmw.window_column) > 0.75
WITH CompletedMigrationsPerInstance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), ImageTypeMetadataWithWindowMem AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT im.metadata_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.instance_uuid) AS instances_with_completed_migrations, AVG(cm.completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_instance, MAX(cm.completed_migration_count) AS max_completed_migrations_per_instance, SUM(cm.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed_bytes, AVG(im.window_column) AS avg_window_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationsPerInstance AS cm JOIN ImageTypeMetadataWithWindowMem AS im ON cm.instance_uuid = im.instance_uuid GROUP BY im.metadata_value ORDER BY instances_with_completed_migrations DESC
WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND NOT m.STATUS IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS), HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ AS (SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT h.VM_STATE, h.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, a.migration_status, h.instance_count AS prime35_instance_count, a.instance_count AS active_migration_instance_count, h.min_memory_mb, a.min_memory_total, ROUND(a.min_memory_total / NULLIF(h.min_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ AS h JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState AS a ON h.VM_STATE = a.vm_state ORDER BY Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio DESC

WITH InstanceMigrationDispersion AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL AND i.key_name <> '' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, imd.migration_count_range, imd.migration_count_variance, imd.migration_count_stddev FROM TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm JOIN InstanceMigrationDispersion AS imd ON tcm.display_name = imd.display_name WHERE imd.migration_count_range > 0 ORDER BY tcm.completed_migrations DESC
WITH MemoryStddevPrime AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT msp.display_name, msp.memory_mb_stddev, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM MemoryStddevPrime AS msp JOIN RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS rgb ON rgb.display_name = msp.display_name ORDER BY msp.memory_mb_stddev DESC, rgb.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.metadata_count_range, m.metadata_count_variance, m.metadata_count_stddev, s.memory_mb_stddev FROM MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS m JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS s ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = s.display_name ORDER BY m.metadata_count_range DESC
WITH RootGBStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), MigrationCountStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), Prime35MigrationCountStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name) SELECT rgs.DISPLAY_NAME, rgs.root_gb_range, rgs.root_gb_variance, pmcs.migration_count_range, pmcs.migration_count_variance, pmcs.migration_count_stddev FROM RootGBStats AS rgs JOIN Prime35MigrationCountStats AS pmcs ON rgs.DISPLAY_NAME = pmcs.display_name ORDER BY rgs.root_gb_range DESC
WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationMemoryStatsOnHost AS (SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status, cm.migration_type, cm.uuid, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS cm JOIN MigrationMemoryStatsOnHost AS ms ON cm.status = ms.status) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY status, uuid, window_column
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.`key`, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra AS ie JOIN instances AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.`key` HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq2.`key` AS system_metadata_key, sq1.min_migration_id, sq1.avg_instance_memory_mb, sq2.max_memory_mb FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.max_memory_mb DESC, sq2.display_name, sq2.`key`

WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare')), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON imw.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY imw.display_name, imw.uuid

WITH InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.`KEY`, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMigrationCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.VM_STATE, imr.`KEY`, imr.VALUE, imr.window_column, imcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMetadataRanks AS imr JOIN InstanceMigrationCV AS imcv ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = imcv.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imr.UUID, imr.`KEY`, imr.window_column

WITH PerInstanceMetadataDispersion AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL AND i.key_name <> '' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10), AllPrimeCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime')) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, pimd.metadata_count_range, pimd.metadata_count_variance, pimd.metadata_count_stddev FROM TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm JOIN PerInstanceMetadataDispersion AS pimd ON tcm.display_name = pimd.display_name JOIN (SELECT instance_uuid, COUNT(migration_id) AS total_completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM AllPrimeCompletedMigrations GROUP BY instance_uuid) AS apcm ON apcm.instance_uuid IN (SELECT i.uuid FROM instances AS i WHERE i.display_name = tcm.display_name AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime')) WHERE (tcm.completed_migrations * 1.0 / apcm.total_completed_migrations_for_display_name) > 0.75 ORDER BY tcm.completed_migrations DESC
WITH InstanceNetworkCache AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.`KEY`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.DISPLAY_NAME, inc.vm_state, inc.memory_mb, inc.network_info, ifm.FLAVOR, ifm.`KEY`, inc.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_dense_rank FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS ifm JOIN InstanceNetworkCache AS inc ON ifm.DISPLAY_NAME = inc.display_name ORDER BY ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.`KEY`
WITH InstanceMetadataRows AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), HighMemoryVmStates AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT imr.instance_uuid, imr.display_name, imr.vm_state, imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.metadata_key, imr.metadata_value, imr.window_column, hms.total_memory_mb FROM InstanceMetadataRows AS imr JOIN HighMemoryVmStates AS hms ON imr.vm_state = hms.VM_STATE ORDER BY imr.vm_state, imr.metadata_key, imr.window_column, imr.instance_uuid
WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), DisplayNameMetaStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN (SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT d.instance_uuid, d.display_name, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.instance_extra_id, d.max_instance_id_next_2, ms.meta_count_range, ms.meta_count_variance, ms.meta_count_stddev FROM InstanceDetails AS d JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS ms ON ms.display_name = d.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name, d.instance_uuid
WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.`key`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ImageTypeMetadata AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.`key` AS instance_system_metadata_key, itm.metadata_value, itm.network_info, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, itm.window_column AS image_type_row_number FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN ImageTypeMetadata AS itm ON md.display_name = itm.display_name ORDER BY md.display_name, itm.metadata_value
WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.status AS migration_status, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.avg_memory_mb, sq2.memory_mb_variance FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.memory_mb_variance DESC
WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC
WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id, DISPLAY_NAME
WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC), Flare3FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances AS f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC
WITH migration_details AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.`key`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.`key` AS instance_system_metadata_key, md.window_column, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM migration_details AS md JOIN root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS rgb ON md.display_name = rgb.display_name
WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT md.migration_id, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.DISPLAY_NAME AS migrated_instance_display_name, md.MEMORY_MB AS migrated_instance_memory_mb, md.metadata_key, md.metadata_value, md.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, imr.instance_uuid, imr.vm_state, imr.memory_mb AS az_instance_memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, ROUND(md.MEMORY_MB / NULLIF(imr.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS migrated_to_az_memory_ratio FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN InstanceMetadataRanks AS imr ON md.metadata_key = imr.metadata_key AND md.metadata_value = imr.metadata_value ORDER BY migrated_to_az_memory_ratio DESC, md.migration_id, imr.instance_uuid
WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare')), VMStateGeoMean AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT id.display_name, id.availability_zone, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.uuid, id.max_metadata_id_next_2, vmg.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM InstanceDetails AS id LEFT JOIN VMStateGeoMean AS vmg ON id.vm_state = vmg.vm_state
WITH Prime35InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Blaze812InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT p.display_name, p.memory_mb_variance AS prime35_memory_mb_variance, p.memory_mb_stddev AS prime35_memory_mb_stddev, b.avg_memory_mb AS blaze812_avg_memory_mb, b.memory_mb_variance AS blaze812_memory_mb_variance FROM Prime35InstanceMemoryStats AS p JOIN Blaze812InstanceMemoryStats AS b ON p.display_name = b.display_name ORDER BY p.memory_mb_variance DESC
WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC
WITH ImageTypeMetadataOnHost AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstancesInAZOnHost AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT iaoh.vm_state, AVG(iaoh.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT iaoh.instance_uuid) AS instance_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT itmo.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_ImageType_Metadata_On_Host FROM InstancesInAZOnHost AS iaoh LEFT JOIN ImageTypeMetadataOnHost AS itmo ON iaoh.display_name = itmo.display_name WHERE iaoh.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY iaoh.vm_state HAVING AVG(iaoh.memory_mb) > 16000 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC
WITH Flare3CompletedFlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.instance_display_name, f.migration_status, f.window_column AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS migration_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS source_compute, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS dest_compute, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Flare3 flare* instances (completed migrations)' AS reason FROM Flare3CompletedFlareInstances AS f UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS CHAR(36)) AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS migration_status, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS running_memory_sum_within_migration_type, c.migration_id, c.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, c.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, c.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status, 'Completed migrations on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlazeHost AS c) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_display_name, migration_id
WITH InstanceTimeVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), HostVcpuStateSummary AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT hvss.VM_STATE, hvss.DISPLAY_NAME, hvss.instance_count, hvss.min_memory_mb, itv.coefficient_of_variation FROM HostVcpuStateSummary AS hvss JOIN InstanceTimeVariation AS itv ON hvss.DISPLAY_NAME = itv.display_name
